substeps.caption: EVAC/AIR vents the chamber; the door comes straight out with the X-Y stage on it. In the stage's socket: our holder for 1.5 in mounts, an aluminium cup with a spring plunger through its side.
The conductive hot mount (carbon-filled phenolic) drops into the cup and the plunger presses it against the wall: coupon -> compound -> cup -> stage, the path to ground.
Door in, EVAC/AIR: about three minutes to vacuum. Then BSE images and EDS; the detector is built in, and the box on the right is its analyser, Oxford Instruments' AZtecOne.
The polished section in backscattered electrons (illustrative: no image of this section exists yet).
